Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.pgsql

Class PostgresProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.query.Processor
org.aristonis.diwan.database.pgsql.PostgresProcessor
public class PostgresProcessor extends Processor
Processes PostgreSQL query results, a hand port of Laravel's Illuminate\Database\Query\Processors\PostgresProcessor.

Instances hold no state and are safe to share between threads.

  • Method Details

    • processInsertGetId

      public Object processInsertGetId(Builder query, String sql, List<Object> values, String sequence)
      Runs an insert of one row and returns the new key.

      Laravel's base processor runs the insert and asks PDO for the last insert id. JDBC has no portable equivalent, and the right way differs per database (returning, or last_insert_rowid() on the same session), so this is the seam a database module's processor fills.

      Overrides:
      processInsertGetId in class Processor
      Parameters:
      query - the query, never null
      sql - the compiled insert, never null
      values - the prepared bindings, never null
      sequence - the key column, never null
      Returns:
      the new key: a Long when it is numeric, else as the database returned it
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the statement returns no row or no sequence column, for example when the connection only pretends to run statements
      Implementation Note:
      Runs sql, an insert ... returning statement, as a read on query.getConnection() and returns the sequence column of the row it returns.
